article.title: Richmond Hill South
article.description: Federal electoral district in Ontario, Canada
article.extract: Richmond Hill South is a federal electoral district in Ontario, Canada, that has been represented in the House of Commons of Canada since 2004.

turns.guesser:
My read: 💲🪙 = gold (substitute), 🌄🔻 = mining or digging into a mountain, so a gold-mining place. 🇺🇸⤴️ = the far north of the US (Alaska?), and 🥞🐻‍❄️ = "Flat" + Alaska. Is it a gold-rush town in Alaska? What does ☑️☑️🧩 mean: census-designated place, or a ghost town?

GUESS: Flat, Alaska

Reading: 🇺🇸⤴️⤴️🥶 = Canada, 🇬🇧👸 = British Columbia (the name Queen Victoria chose), ☑️☑️👥🪑 = an electoral district (votes for a seat). 🪙🪙🏦😎 = "Rich", 🌄 = "mond/mount", 🐧↘️ = "South". So: Richmond South... Is there more to the title, like "Centre"?

GUESS: Richmond South Centre

Got it: 🪙🌄 = Richmond is right, 👦👧🪣 = Jack and Jill went up the Hill, 🐧↘️ = South. Not BC, but Ontario (🌊×5 = Great Lakes). So it's the riding in Richmond Hill, Ontario.

GUESS: Richmond Hill South
